about: Layer registry: every input the dashboard uses or has tried. Ladder: idea -> tested -> info -> proven -> approved -> live (retired). Only approved/live layers may affect the picks. See breadth/research.py and DECISIONS.md.

layers.name: Breadth regime
layers.what: Stockbee-style 4% up/down ratios, T2108 -> strong / mixed / weak / thrust

layers.name: Playbook state + setup verdicts
layers.what: post-thrust or breadth regime; each setup Focus / Selective / Avoid by backtested R in that state

layers.name: Thrust watch (live)
layers.what: live 4% up count vs 40-day avg; thrust pace >= 2.5x

layers.name: Washout thrust card
layers.what: thrusts after SPY -8% and T2108 <= 25 -> high-beta RS 80+ leaders for ~1 month

layers.name: Money in or out (dollar share)
layers.what: share of $ volume in falling stocks; >= 70% days followed by SPY +1.3% next 5

layers.name: Volume tilt
layers.what: relvol of up movers vs down movers, 10-day; low outside thrust windows -> SPY -4% next 21

layers.name: Narrowing / highs context
layers.what: many stocks near highs followed by weaker SPY 20d (context)

layers.name: Theme / sub-theme Strength
layers.what: relative perf + EMA breadth + median RS, 0-100

layers.name: Rotation: leading & accelerating
layers.what: group line above rising 20-day, near 60-day high, top 20% 20d -> ideas

layers.name: Money flow tiers (RRG)
layers.what: confirmed / steady / new / fading / outflow per sub-theme

layers.name: Group ignition + Day 1
layers.what: 4-check ignition; Day 1 breakout needs 3-day follow-through

layers.name: Pick context re-rank
layers.what: +1 ignited sub-theme; in outflow episodes +1 sold-hardest / -1 held-up group

layers.name: RS Rating + leaders score
layers.what: RS 1-99; leaders = 60% RS + 40% closeness to high

layers.name: Trade setups (ATH, pullback, rotation, Q-flag, VCP, round number, box retest, box spring)
layers.what: setup masks + backtest by state

layers.name: Conviction tags
layers.what: RS high/ahead, burst, coil, top theme...; none adds edge at t >= 2

layers.name: Record volume warning
layers.what: up days on record volume lagged SPY ~-5% over 10 sessions

layers.name: Macro fit (rates / oil / dollar)
layers.what: market-neutral sensitivities + 5-day tailwind; failed its backtest

layers.name: Calendar (earnings + events)
layers.what: earnings inside the hold, high-impact events; forward-logged

layers.name: Catalyst (why it's moving)
layers.what: direction / quality / red flags with sources; forward-logged

layers.name: Macro brief
layers.what: rates, Fed, oil, geopolitics, event risk; forward-logged

layers.name: Position-trade exits
layers.what: 3-month holds: hold or 50-EMA trail beat 10/21-EMA trails

layers.name: Sizing high-ADR leaders
layers.what: size so a ~30% drawdown is ~1% of account instead of adding names

layers.name: Hidden buying (FINRA short share)
layers.what: S&P 500 off-exchange short share 5-day vs 120-day normal; top fifth -> SPY +3.1% next 21 (experimental)

layers.name: Who won the close
layers.what: descriptive: where stocks closed in their range; no forward edge

layers.name: Strength on Weakness (weekly position setup)
layers.where: breadth/sow.py → DATA.themes.sow, Trade Setups tab sowCard
layers.what: weekly stage-1 base + 9/21 WEMA re-anchor; breakout / nuzzle / pop states for multi-month holds
layers.notes: beats the average stock but not other RS 70+ stocks yet; only ~1 year testable

layers.name: Market health (leaders + breakouts working)
layers.what: leaders' breakouts/breakdowns, 50-day recovery check, universe base breakouts vs breakdowns and follow-through
layers.notes: no forward edge in 410 days; untested in a bear market
